tips.text: Major cities in Eastern Region: Birkirkara, Għargħur, Gżira, Iklin, Lija, Msida, Pembroke, Pietà, San Ġiljan, Sliema, Swieqi, and Ta’ Xbiex
Major cities in Gozo Region: Fontana, Għajnsielem, Għarb, Għasri, Kerċem, Munxar, Nadur, Qala, San Lawrenz, Sannat, Rabat (Victoria), Xagħra, Xewkija, and Żebbuġ
Major cities in Northern Region: Attard, Balzan, Mellieħa, Mġarr, Mosta, Mtarfa, Naxxar, San Ġwann, and St. Paul's Bay
Major cities in Port Region: Birgu, Bormla, Fgura, Floriana, Kalkara, Paola, Senglea, Tarxien, Valletta, Xgħajra, and Żabbar
Major cities in Southern Region: Birżebbuġa, Għaxaq, Gudja, Ħamrun, Luqa, Marsa, Marsaskala, Marsaxlokk, Qormi, Santa Luċija, Santa Venera, and Żejtun
Major cities in Western Region: Dingli, Kirkop, Mdina, Mqabba, Qrendi, Rabat, Safi, Siġġiewi, Żebbuġ, and Żurrieq
